title.narrative: Risk Capital Facility for the Southern Neighbourhood countries

description.narrative: The aim of the Facility is to pool public and private resources through risk capital instruments for the financing of private equity and venture capital funds and microfinance institutions, with the purpose of providing financing to local Micro- Small- and Medium sized enterprises (SMEs) in the Southern Neighbourhood. The Risk Capital Facility will provide access to equity and debt financing to SMEs in order to support private sector development, inclusive growth and private sector job creatio

comment.narrative: The Annual Report of this intervention covering period up to 31 December 2021 on pages 16 to 19 indicates the following information As of the end of 2021 the private equity subwindow was deployed in five funds of which four adopt a regional investment strategy and one is targeting investments in Egypt. Collectively these funds have raised approximately EUR 781m representing a multiple of 12x the EIBs commitment to these funds. Two new microfinance operations were signed in 2021 for a total amount equivalent to EUR 15m split between two different countries. In the period 20172020 the EIB provided financing to five MFIs and two microfinance funds in the Southern Neighbourhood amounting in total to EUR 43.7m of which the EC contribution is 13 equivalent to EUR 14.6m.Thus total number of FIs served 5 2 7 14
